title: Sales and ledger
page_description: Revenue, collections, account transfers and staff payouts of the period, each on its own; below, the sale lines and the customer ledger. Nothing is deleted: a wrong sale line is reversed or corrected.
forbidden: You are not allowed to see the sales ledger.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters and try again.
lines.load_failed: Sale lines could not be loaded.
lines.empty_title: No sale lines in this period
lines.empty_description: Completed reservations and product sales are listed here as sale lines.
entries.load_failed: Ledger entries could not be loaded.
entries.empty_title: No ledger entries in this period
entries.empty_description: Sale charges, package charges, collections and refunds are listed here.
drawer.title: Sale line
drawer.description: A line is never changed. A wrong one is reversed or corrected; both are dated today, so earlier days keep their figures.
drawer.load_failed: The sale line could not be loaded.
entry_drawer.title: Ledger entry
entry_drawer.description: What the customer owes and paid. Payments and refunds are taken on the reservation.
reverse_dialog.title: Reverse the sale line
reverse_dialog.description: The exact negative of the line is written with today's date and the customer's charge is reversed too. The line itself stays; this cannot be undone.
correct_dialog.title: Correct the sale line
correct_dialog.description: Current net amount: {{net}}. The old line is closed with a reversal and a line with the new values is written; both are dated today.
correct_dialog.price_locked: Changing the price needs the price override permission.
correct_dialog.discount_locked: Changing the discount needs the discount permission.
correct_dialog.reason_hint: The reason stays on both new lines.
validation.quantity: Quantity must be a whole number between 1 and 100000.
validation.discount_too_large: The discount cannot exceed the line total.
validation.nothing_changed: Change at least one of quantity, unit price or discount.
validation.reason_min: The reason must be at least 3 characters.
validation.reason_max: The reason can be at most 500 characters.
summary.load_failed: The summary could not be loaded.
summary.empty: No revenue, collections, transfers or staff payouts in this period.
summary.transfers_hint: Money moved between accounts; not revenue.
summary.staff_payments_hint: Staff payouts from the cash book.
summary.days_empty_description: Days with revenue, collections, transfers or staff payouts are listed here.
balance.load_failed: The balance could not be loaded.
balance.expected_booked: Until the visit is completed the amount is the booked total.
balance.expected_posted: The amount is the net of the visit's sale lines.
balance.lines_empty: The sale lines appear here once the visit is completed.
balance.customer_description: Sale and package charges, payments and the balance; a positive balance is owed by the customer, a negative one is held for them.
balance.customer_empty_description: The balance appears here once the customer has a sale, package, collection or refund.
